title: Elon Musk
subtitle: Visionary, Entrepreneur, Innovator
author: Walusimbi Leon (SGSS)
description: The visionary behind Tesla, SpaceX, and Twitter/X — the story of how a boy from Pretoria became the wealthiest human in recorded history and reshaped the modern world.
style: Authoritative, engaging, journalistic prose. Factual, with narrative drive.

setting: Pretoria, California, Texas, and the world.
notes: The book has 15 planned chapters and is roughly two-thirds written (ends around the Twitter/X acquisition era). Continue with the remaining chapters: controversies, wealth and empire, famous quotes, legacy and future. Keep it factual and balanced.
